title: koanophyllon littorale
intro: Koanophyllon littorale, commonly known as the Littoral Koanophyllon, is a plant species that belongs to the family Asteraceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions due to its numerous health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties.
